name: order-tshirt
description: POST /orders with the IT's JSON order: DataWeave maps it to ns0:OrderTshirt, the AuthenticationHeader apiKey abc12345 is added as SOAP header, OrderTshirt is invoked (SOAPAction order-tshirt) and the OrderTshirtResponse is returned as JSON with 200.

source.reference: web-service-consumer/src/main/app/tshirt-service-consumer.xml (dw ns0#OrderTshirt: payload; dw soap.header AuthenticationHeader apiKey; ws:consumer operation=OrderTshirt; dw %output application/json payload); tshirt.wsdl (soapAction http://mulesoft.org/tshirt-service/order-tshirt); src/test/resources/message.json; sample_data/OrderTshirtResponse.xml; WebServiceConsumerIT asserts 'orderId'
